display_long_description:
**Build it. Sail it. Survive it.**

Build A Boat To Survive is a VR boat-building survival game. You don’t have to reach a finish line. You just have to still be floating when the disaster ends. Build, fight, and survive.

[media]

**BUILD YOUR BOAT BLOCK BY BLOCK**

Grab wood blocks, seats, cannons, sails and more, and snap them together with your own hands in the shipyard. Every boat needs a ship’s wheel, a mainsail and a seat. After that it’s up to you. Build a wide raft that’s hard to sink, a fast sloop that can outrun trouble, or a floating fortress full of cannons. Pick your captain’s colour, press READY and launch.

[media]

**21 DISASTERS. ONE BOAT.**
Once you’re out on the water, the sea turns on you.

[media]

**SURVIVE TOGETHER**

Play with friends or jump into matches with players online. Build side by side, crew one boat together, or race to see whose boat sinks last. Grab the wheel, pull a mate back on board, and yell when the Kraken shows up.

**EARN GOLD AND RANK UP**

Each match pays out gold and Captain XP for taking part, staying alive and throwing skeletons overboard.

Grab your hammer and hoist the sail. The sea is coming.
